sn45.150:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci bījagāmā bhūtagāmā vuddhim viruḷhim vepullaṃ āppajjanti || sabbe te pathaviṃ nissāya pathaviyam patiṭṭhāya evam ete bījagāmā bhūtagāmā vuddhim virūḷhim vepullam āpajjanti || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlam nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam pāpuṇāti dhammesu || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vuddhiṃ {virūḷhiṃ} vepullam pāpuṇāti dhammesu || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya a- a- bhāvento a- abahulīkaronto vuddhiṃ {virūḷhiṃ vepullam} papuṇāti dhammesū ti || || Himavantam
